title: QClaw: Tencent Desktop AI Automation Agent
summary: QClaw is a zero-configuration AI agent ecosystem that automates desktop tasks through a mobile interface. It runs locally on Windows or Mac devices and leverages the Hunyuan 3.0 model for complex multi-step reasoning.
research_notes: Features a local-first architecture where the smartphone acts as a remote control endpoint; Tencent claims 99% of the international version's code was self-generated by the agent.

evolution.summary: Initially a desktop automation tool, QClaw evolved into an integrated platform within WeChat and QQ by early 2026. It launched a global beta in April 2026, transitioning to a full-scenario agent capable of managing productivity, planning, and automotive tasks.
